name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Before I sold anything for a living, I bought fan and ventilation equipment for a living. As co-owner of a licensed cannabis cultivation facility, I specified and selected the exhaust and intake fans, ducting, climate control, and CO2 systems that kept the grow running, and I sat across the table from equipment vendors to evaluate options and make the buying decision. I know what a technical buyer actually weighs when comparing airflow and climate-control equipment, because I have been that buyer.

I have spent the 15 years since building a B2B sales career on that same foundation: full-cycle ownership, technical solution scoping, and account growth. At Accelo, I guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations as a trusted advisor to C-suite executives, and ranked top three in sales on a team that scaled from 8 to 15 reps, sustaining that rank through a 27-month tenure while quota roughly doubled. I am proficient across four CRM platforms and have consistently managed a full sales cycle from first contact through close, expansion, and renewal.

I do not have a formal engineering degree or prior HVAC industry sales experience, but I understand this equipment from the buyer's side and I know how to run a sales process. I would welcome the chance to talk through how that combination applies to ZIEHL-ABEGG's OEM accounts.
